race.comment: COL KLINK (1) resumes having won his only start last time in, scoring a maiden victory at Geelong as the $1.50 favourite. Since spelled again but has won a jumpout and can make his presence felt. KIPPIS (3) resumes. She showed good ability in her maiden campaign, also winning at $1.50 before a break. The market has held a good opinion of her to date and with even luck she'll take beating. EETEEDEE (4) resumes off a long break but did contest a Listed race at Flemington first up last time in and has jumped out well. Damian Lane booked and she can run well. SHAPENAPIT (6) resumed with a nice maiden win as favourite here and is well placed to go on with it. GOLDEN PULSE (11) resumes having shown ability last time in. Watch the market.
